about: What each kind of doodle shows, for screen readers and image search (Nan, 2026-10-10: "We have a ton of doodles that need labeling"). One entry per drawing kind: a place portrait set, a scene, a front-page set, a minisite drawing. doodles_layer.py, doodlerepo_layer.py, front_layer.py and the browser scripts compose a doodle's label from it plus the doodle's own name. tests/test_alt_text.py fails a build that publishes a kind missing here. Written from the drawings as rendered 2026-10-10. A place portrait varies from place to place, so a kind that draws places names the building and what showed in every one checked; when a kind's drawing changes, its words change with it.
